description: 令和6年能登半島地震(斜め撮影)【朝日航洋株式会社】 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by エアロトヨタ株式会社. 令和6年1月1日16時10分に石川県能登地方を震源とする地震が発生しました。 被災されました皆様に心よりお見舞い申し上げ、1日も早く元の生活を取り戻せますよう祈念いたします。 朝日航洋株式会社（代表取締役社長：加藤浩士、本社：東京都江東区）は、アジア航測株式会社（代表取締役社長：畠山仁）と共同で、被害状況を把握するため、1月2日に緊急撮影... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher エアロトヨタ株式会社. Its tags are 令和6年能登半島地震, 斜め写真. It offers 36 resource(s) in csv, jpeg. The portal shows 2025-09-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
